request.state:
L01: The museum stands at the top of the market square.
L02: Entry is free and a donation is welcome.
L03: The building is open every day but Christmas Day.
L04: From Monday to Saturday the doors open at ten.
L05: The last entry is half an hour before closing.
L06: On a Sunday the doors open at noon.
L07: Closing is at five throughout the year.
L08: The upper gallery closes an hour earlier in winter.
L09: The tea room keeps its own hours, which are on its door.
L10: Large bags are left at the desk.
L11: Photography without a flash is allowed everywhere.
L12: School groups book in advance through the education office.

q1.instructions: Which line gives the time the museum opens on a Sunday?
